name: Mother's Day Illuminated Canvases
summary: A special project where participants build decorative canvases that come to life in the dark, combining handmade art and electronics in a light and affectionate way 💝 This project was developed for the Connect Byte Mother's Day workshop and introduces electronics concepts through a creative and meaningful experience.

name: Catapult Mission
summary: A practical project combining basic engineering and reasoning, where participants build a functional catapult by solving challenges.

name: Byte do Milhão 💜🎮
summary: Real-time game show by the Connect Byte community: June Meetup (FIAP + MagaluCloud).

name: Arduino Float Car Robot
summary: A creative robotics project where participants build an autonomous float car robot using Arduino.

name: Automatic Plant Irrigator with Arduino
summary: A practical home automation project where participants build a system that monitors soil moisture and irrigates plants automatically.

name: Arduino LED Lamp
summary: A simple creative electronics project where participants build a small LED lamp using Arduino.

name: Mechanical Melody
summary: A creative electronics project where participants build an interactive sound box using an Arduino, a membrane keypad, and a buzzer.

name: Physical Financial Planner
summary: A planner that connects financial organization on paper, data recognition on the Connect Byte website, and goal tracking on a physical device with an ESP32-C3 and OLED display.

name: Interactive LED Planner
summary: A hands-on electronics project where participants build an interactive habit tracker or daily planner inside a picture frame.

name: Easter Physical Tamagotchi
summary: A creative electronics project where participants build an interactive Easter-themed object that blends crafting, storytelling, and hardware in a playful and hands-on way ✨

name: Arduino RGB TV
summary: A creative electronics project where participants build a mini cardboard television with interactive RGB lighting controlled by an Arduino and a push-button.
